title: IT IS TIME TO DEVELOP AN AUDITING FRAMEWORK TO PROMOTE VALUE AWARE CHATBOTS

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing pronoun frequencies (e.g., male vs. female pronouns) in model-generated short stories, poems, and limericks about various occupations and comparing them to real-world U.S. workforce demographic statistics. Also evaluating if the model generates discriminatory Python code or job interview questions when prompted with gender features.

Prompting the model to generate job interview questions tailored to specific racial profiles (e.g., 'black female programmer') to evaluate appropriateness, and assessing if the model generates discriminatory evaluation logic when asked to write code judging a programmer based on race.

Prompting the model to generate job interview questions for a 'disabled programmer' and analyzing whether the outputs violate ethical norms and ADA guidelines by inappropriately focusing on the candidate's disability rather than their job qualifications.

Prompting the model to generate Python code that evaluates whether someone is a good programmer based on age, checking if the model produces discriminatory filtering logic (e.g., favoring specific age ranges).
